about: The fields the brain (Python) READS in the body's API answers (bot/src/api/api.js), with their types.
Checked on both sides, so that the two cannot drift apart without a test failing:
bot/tests/unit/contract.test.js: the real API answers have every field listed here, with this type;
brain/tests/test_contract.py: the fake body of the Python tests (brain/tests/fakes.py) too.
Types: string, number, boolean, object, array, null; 'a|b' = either. A nested object = the fields of that
object; '*' = every entry of an object; a list with one element = every item of a list.
A field ending with '?' may be left out by the FAKE body (the brain reads it with .get); the real API
always sends it. Extra fields are allowed: this is what the brain needs, not all that the body sends.
Not here: POST /setup (only used by the benches, and its server commands cannot run in a unit test).
